description: Observe-only Newark alert. If private Home Context signal diagnostics remains non-Healthy for five minutes, create or update one fixed Home Assistant persistent notification. Dismiss it on Healthy or Resolved. Never repairs configuration, controls a device, sends a mobile push, or changes AI Actions.

triggers.note: Alert only after the diagnostic fault remains stable for five continuous minutes.
A bounded proposal remains observe-only until separately approved.
Fail closed when the private diagnostics report is unavailable.
Fail closed when the diagnostics state is unknown.
Clear the fixed notification when diagnostics recovers.
Resolved is a recovery lifecycle state and clears the alert.

data.title: Home Context signal issue

sequence.note: Fixed notification_id deduplicates repeated fault alerts by updating one persistent notification.
Recovery removes only this automation's persistent notification.
